subject: physical-education
unitTitle: Lifetime Activity Audit and Adult Transition Planning
title: Independent application A: activities that require nothing but space and time
focus: activities that require nothing but space and time
essentialQuestion: Which of the things I do now will still be possible next year?
privacySafeScenario: Audit every activity the learner currently does against post-graduation constraints, then design a minimum viable activity week that would survive the worst plausible version of next year.
studentTask: Learner applies activities that require nothing but space and time in a new situation at a self-set intensity and records what they did, noticed, and would adjust.
knowledgeCheck: In one concise response, explain the key idea behind activities that require nothing but space and time and name one adjustment for the next session.
completionCriteria: The learner completes or fully describes the activities that require nothing but space and time task using a version their body and setting allow.
The learner gives a cue, principle, tactic, or documented process rather than an unexplained result.
The learner self-assesses against the stated criteria and identifies one next adjustment.
adaptationChoices: The audit may be written, tabled, or spoken. A learner whose next year is uncertain builds the plan against two or three scenarios instead of one.
extensionChallenge: Apply activities that require nothing but space and time under a new constraint, in a different activity, or teach the cue to someone else — without completing another learner's graded work.
accessibilitySupports: Provide readable text plus optional audio or read-aloud support; no voice feature is required.
Chunk directions into one action at a time and show a worked example or model.
Allow typed, handwritten, spoken, drawn, demonstrated, or described responses when the standard permits.
Offer reduced-copying, extended-time, hidden-timer, rest-break, and low-distraction options.
Use captions, alt text, high-contrast print, keyboard access, and text-only fallbacks for media.
Preserve the learning target while adjusting quantity, pacing, intensity, range, equipment, or response mode.
Every movement task has a seated, supported, reduced-range, reduced-pace, and solo version that reaches the same standard.
The audit may be written, tabled, or spoken. A learner whose next year is uncertain builds the plan against two or three scenarios instead of one.

optionalReflection.prompt: Invite the learner to notice or try one safe, optional example of activities that require nothing but space and time in daily life. No purchase, account creation, photograph, recording, or public performance is required.

neverRequires: This task never requires body weight, height, BMI, or body-fat percentage.
This task never requires calorie counting or a diet or weight-loss goal.
This task never requires disclosing private medical history, a diagnosis, or sexual history.
This task never requires a photograph, video, or voice recording of the learner as proof.
This task never requires a public performance or an audience.
